title_en: Opportunity!! In Don Bosco, at the Manhattan complex, 1+1 apartment for sale, ideal for investment!!
description_en: Opportunity!! In Don Bosco, at the Manhattan complex, 1+1 apartment for sale, ideal for investment!!! The apartment has a total area of ​​84.7m2 gross and 67.8m2 net. The apartment is located on the 13th floor of a 31-story residence, in the initial phase of construction. The apartment is organized in the living room together with the kitchen corner, a corridor that divides the premises, a matrimonial room, a toilet and a balcony that describes all the premises of the apartment. The orientation of the apartment is south-west with natural light. Some of the benefits of the complex are: ventilated facade with thermal insulation and acoustic insulation; gas-filled double-glazed windows; The building is located on the main road, has access to public transport and is close to banks and institutions.
